info.name: JoodPakPaw V2 Core API
info.description:
Enterprise Postman Collection for JoodPakPaw V2 API Server (Sprint 0 - Sprint 4).
Enforces Single Standard Envelope (`data` wrapper), `camelCase` DTOs, and OWASP Security.

item.name: 05 - Bookings & Reviews Lifecycle (Enterprise V2)
item.description: Booking creation, payment confirmation, Guest/Host cancellation cutoffs, Host completion, Guest 14-day review, and Host one-time public reply.

request.description: Enforces min(createdAt + 24h, checkOut 12:00 ICT) payment deadline and verifies property/host are active and unbanned.
Blocks Guest cancel on confirmed bookings at/after Check-in 14:00 ICT (400 B-4003) and Host cancel at/after Check-out 12:00 ICT (400 B-4003).
Host accepts a pending booking reservation with row-level locking, transitioning status from pending to confirmed.
Host marks confirmed booking as successful (blocked with 400 B-4003 before Check-out 12:00 ICT; auto-completes after 18:00 ICT).
Guest submits 1 verified-stay review within 14 days of stay completion.
Host submits a single public reply (max 500 chars) to a reviewed booking (409 B-4001 if already replied).
